notes: Empty delivery. The folder holds only code/ and mecanico.json: there is no RELATORIO.md and no achados.json (the agent never wrote them), so nothing was reported and C1/C2/R1/R2 are none for every flaw, with no confidences, false positives or extra findings to record. All five delivered files (config.php, index.php, lib.php, schema.sql, seed.sql) are byte-identical to the pristine legacy code (diff -ru empty; sha256 match), so no flaw was fixed or refactored, C3/R3 are none, C5/R4 are none by rule (nothing fixed), and there are no COMP violations or new bugs to charge. The mechanical report agrees: characterization 22/22 green on the untouched code, and all four probes (SEC-001, SEC-008, BUG-001, PERF-001) report corrigida=false. The achados.json leb binding could not be checked because the file is absent. expl_rubric is omitted per the brief (a separate blind judge scores EXPL); with no report to read, that judge has nothing to score.
